info.title: signsofai — detect the signs of AI writing (English & Spanish) and recommend fixes.
info.description: CLI to detect the signs of AI writing (English & Spanish) and recommend fixes — lint your prose in CI.

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the text (default: auto-detect)

options.name: --rules
options.description: Add a custom catalog (rule-pack). Repeatable.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a JSON report instead of the pretty report

options.name: --report
options.description:
Write the evidence as a document you can keep, forward or print.
.md for pasting into an email or an LMS; anything else writes a
self-contained HTML page that prints to PDF from a browser. Every
report carries this build's own false-positive rate.

options.name: --max-score
options.description: Exit with code 1 if the overall score exceeds N (for CI gating)

options.name: --fail-on-artifacts
options.description:
Exit with code 1 if the text holds characters typing cannot produce
(invisible characters, letters impersonating Latin ones)

options.name: --top
options.description: Show at most N findings in the pretty report (default: 10)

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version
BASELINE
Compares a piece against earlier work by the SAME person, using function-word frequencies.
It reports how far the text sits from that writer's centre next to how far their own pieces
sit from it, so the scale is their variation and not a threshold invented here. It cannot
tell you who wrote something, and there is no result meaning "someone else did".
Needs roughly 1,400 words of earlier work and 300 in the piece being checked; below that it
says so instead of producing a number.
